scope: square-okhttp failure text only: 202 cases, 19 distinct messages, 10 test classes, base rate 0.4950. One project. NOT comparable to precomputed/ (17 projects).

gate_arithmetic.stop_criterion: baseline accuracy >= ~0.98 AND its gap to the exact-message lookup inside fold noise

keep_criterion.rule: mean gain over baseline exceeding the SE of paired per-fold differences (the noise-adjusted rule used since phase 08)
keep_criterion.why: under 1.5 points of headroom above TF-IDF and under 0.6 above the lookup; you cannot beat 0.9975 by a noise-clearing margin when the ceiling is 1.0

fine_tune.why_not: not affordability -- compute is free and the corpus is ~$8. 19 distinct messages means the task is memorisation of a tiny vocabulary, so an SLM would learn the same 19-way lookup more expensively with more capacity to overfit. There are almost no unseen phrasings to generalise to.

precomputed_slm_eval.why: the falsifier (baseline below ~0.97) did not fire, so by the pre-registered rule it stays sealed. The gate fired on this project's own evidence and reading the reference numbers afterwards could only tempt a retrofit.

prediction.predicted: gate fires; TF-IDF lands ~0.98, within noise of the lookup; no GPU
prediction.actual: gate fired; TF-IDF 0.9825; gap -0.0150 against SE 0.0155; no GPU

scope_limit: 'No fine-tune' means no fine-tune is justified by the evidence on THIS corpus -- not that SLM distillation never helps for CI explanation. A corpus with hundreds of distinct, novel-phrased messages could flip it, because then generalisation over lexical variety is a real task and TF-IDF's ceiling would sit lower.
